/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c \"
import pandas as pd, re
df=pd.read_excel('field_visit_log.xlsx', header=4)
# Normalize village names
def norm_v(v):
    if pd.isna(v): return ''
    s=str(v).strip()
    s=re.sub(r'\\s+', ' ', s)
    return s.lower()
df['Village_norm']=df['Village'].apply(norm_v)
# Deduplicate Visit ID keeping first occurrence
df=df.drop_duplicates(subset=['Visit ID'], keep='first')
# Filter
mask=(df['State'].str.strip().str.lower()=='odisha') & (df['Programme'].str.strip()=='Health & Nutrition')
filtered=df[mask]
total=int(filtered['Women Reached'].sum())
print('rows', len(filtered))
print(filtered[['Visit ID','Village','Women Reached']])
print('total', total)
\"
"
